title: MMCR experimental data
description: Selected training, human assembly-task and QR-detection measurements curated against the author-supplied 27-page MMCR manuscript. Source observations are preserved, with explicitly derived accuracy and documented differences between source records, figures and prose.
attribution: MMCR experimental data, version 1.1.0; associated research by Qi Wang, Maowei Jiang, Tingtao Yu, Yusong Hu, Zhiyong Dong, Hongfei Ai, Yifan Wang and Peter Búš. Include actual repository/release URL and indicate changes.
attribution_basis: Associated article author list; individual dataset contribution roles were not supplied.

related_publication.title: Mixed reality and machine learning-guided cable robot framework (MMCR) for real-time prefabricated construction automation

correspondence_reference.version: author-supplied preprint manuscript, not independently verified publisher PDF

inventory.note: These are different observation types; do not sum rows as participants or independent experiments.

training_metric.name: Cumulative Reward
training_metric.paper_context: Figure 10 uses Average Reward; Figure 12(b) uses Cumulative Reward; raw tag absent from CSV.

human_placement_selection.basis: Formula and chart lineage; exact rounded manuscript accuracy ranges; plotted distributions and variance bars

block_1.basis: All 8 Figure A3 peak annotations match at 2 decimal places

block_2.basis: Appendix C protocol and Figure A5 distribution/summary correspondence

qr_environment_mapping.note: Paired worksheet block headers themselves omit environment labels; source block IDs retained.

limitations: Main-text means differ from selected records and some appendix values.
Figure 14 caption swaps accuracy and question-frequency panels.
QR source size header and some mean/median labels are inconsistent.
Four QR trial distances exceed the separate range-table maxima and are preserved.
Participant linkage, training seeds and exact per-file training figure mappings are not verified.
No full training environment, model weights, robot tension records or trajectories are included.
